fixed_filters.ADX_DMI: ADX14>=20 and +DI14>-DI14 on completed signal day
fixed_filters.ATR: mean ATR14 over last 5 sessions <=90% of mean ATR14 over last 20, and signal-day true range >= ATR14

validation.note: Baseline should reproduce the previously validated M1-B2 full state-machine result.

limitations: Current 53-symbol universe is projected backward, so survivorship/post-selection bias remains.
All indicator thresholds were fixed before this run; no parameter sweep is performed.
All filters use only the completed signal-day data and earlier information.
RSI and MACD are included as overlap/control indicators, not because they were expected to be independent alpha sources.
